messages.author: fbcfedba2abc5340
messages.subject: Multicore facets?
parts:
Hi guys,

I was wondering if there is an easy way to combine ggplot2 and foreach
(or similar multicore packages) in a way that would let me calculate
facets in parallel. I love that in plyr I can set a simple boolean in
a ddply statement and have it run parallel, and while most ggplot
things don't lend itself as well to that, I can see facets as a case
where you can distribute computing. Is this currently possible, or
even in the works?

-Chris

messages.subject: Re: Multicore facets?
parts:
We are looking into this in RDAV http://rdav.nics.tennessee.edu/ and
hope to have something to report by the end of this summer. Foreach
and plyr in parallel help but grid graphics are also involved. Do you
have an interesting application with facets?

George
